patch: mg-A-sp1-01.patch (diff -ruN a=u753 programs/pump-amm/src, b=lane; apply with patch -p1 inside programs/pump-amm/src)
desc: mg-A-sp1 win01: +0x56710 (trade_v2::execute_sell), only file changed: instructions/swap/trade_v2.rs. Includes mg-A-6 executor groundwork (best-u751-src trade_v2.rs: inline prepare, from_mint(&to_account_info()), emit!/emit_cpi! without clone, error lines aligned, require_gte!(b,out,TooLittle)@821). New: (1) the three executors call the existing `quote_reserves(&a.pool, raw)?` helper (its #[inline(never)] removed): LLVM inlines it into buy/exact/sell, giving the original block order [available, effective, shared err] with the curve code far away, while multi_hop amm_hop keeps the out-of-line copy (0x4fac0 still matched). (2) `transfer_fee::amount_after_fee(&quote_fee_data, buyback_fee)?` moved from a let into the create_*_event argument list (orig builds the TradeEventContext before calling it). (3) execute_sell: accumulator user init moved into a small helper `set_accumulator_user(&mut a.user_volume_accumulator, a.user.as_ref())` (same logic; appended at end of trade_v2.rs) so its blocks sit right after the call like the original; TradeEventContext literal order pool, global_config, base_supply, user, user_volume_accumulator, ...; TradeEventContext declaration order base_supply before user_volume_accumulator (layout unchanged: create_buy_event 0x52070 / create_sell_event 0x52c58 still exact). (4) exact executor: `let mut quote = estimate; if preview > amount { quote = estimate.checked_sub(preview.saturating_sub(amount)).ok_or(..)?; require_gt!(quote, 0, ..)@804 }` (orig skips the zero check when preview <= amount; estimate_buy_quote already guarantees estimate > 0). POSITIONING DEVICES: #[inline(always)] on the new set_accumulator_user helper; blank lines replace removed lines (line-neutral, every error line unchanged); helper appended at the end of trade_v2.rs. Behavior: same calls, checks, errors, CPI order and events (amount_after_fee is pure; the helper keeps the same condition). Partials: buy 0x53350 104 diff lines (656 before), exact 0x54a20 537 (741 before), cashback 0x4c750 unchanged 376.
